metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully enabled VLC fullscreen by pressing 'f' key in 2 turns. Quick and efficient keyboard shortcut usage.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can interact with VLC, use keyboard shortcuts, understand VLC UI and menus
metadata.task_rationale: Successful trajectory - designed a harder VLC preferences task requiring navigation to Tools > Preferences to change max volume from default 125% to 200%.
metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating VLC preferences to set maximum volume to 200%. Evaluator reads vlcrc config and checks qt-max-volume value equals 200.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter (vlc_config/get_vlc_config) correctly reads the VLC vlcrc configuration file from the VM
Metric (check_qt_max_volume) correctly parses vlcrc for 'qt-max-volume=' key and compares against expected value '200'
Expected parameter handling is correct: with type='rule', get_rule returns rules dict directly, and metric accesses rule['expected_qt_max_volume'] which yields '200'
Default value of '125' in the metric matches VLC's actual default max volume, so missing key case is handled correctly
Single instruction requirement (set max volume to 200%) is fully covered by the evaluator
No postconfig needed since vlcrc is a persistent config file, not dependent on UI state
